blocks.text: Taylor Swift has entered the building. The pop powerhouse lit up the 2026 Country Music Association Awards Wednesday night, performing her song for the “Toy Story 5” film, “I Knew It, I Knew You” — with a bit of her 2006 country hit “Our Song” mixed in for good measure. She began backstage, in the halls of Nashville’s famed Bridgestone Arena, before hitting the stage, joined by Keith Urban on banjo, as if no time had passed. But it’s been 13 years since Swift last performed at the CMA Awards, a decade after her last appearance there and 17 years after […]...
